Eco-Friendly Features

Wool-blend felt is a natural, biodegradable material made from renewable sheep wool. Unlike synthetic alternatives, it breaks down naturally at end of life. Polyester felt options use recycled fibers. Both types are durable enough for 50+ reuses, making them a sustainable choice for premium brand packaging.

Felt vs Canvas Bags

Felt Bags

  • Structured form — maintains shape
  • Soft, tactile texture — premium feel
  • Vibrant solid colors — 30+ options
  • Color-blocked designs available
  • Heavier material — 2-5mm thickness
  • Ideal for designer brands and retail

Canvas Bags

  • Flexible form — soft drape
  • Natural cotton texture — casual feel
  • Limited stock colors — mostly natural/white/black
  • Single color per bag typically
  • Lighter material — 8-16oz cotton
  • Ideal for everyday promotions and events

Printing & Customization Options

Felt's unique surface allows for premium customization techniques that elevate your brand:

  • Silk-screen Printing: Best for simple 1-3 color logos, cost-effective for bulk orders
  • Heat Transfer: Full-color printing for complex designs and photos
  • Embroidery: Premium tactile branding, ideal for high-end brands
  • Laser Engraving: Subtle, elegant branding that reveals the felt's inner color
  • Color-Blocked Design: Combine 2-3 felt colors for a unique, branded look
  • Custom Tags & Labels: Sewn-in branded tags for a professional finish

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for felt bags?

Our MOQ is 100 pcs per design. For custom PMS color matching, the minimum is 500 pcs. Sample orders of 10-50 pcs are available for evaluation.

What felt materials do you offer?

We offer wool-blend felt (premium, natural texture) and polyester felt (cost-effective, vibrant colors). Thickness options range from 2mm (lightweight) to 5mm (heavy-duty structured).

Can I get color-blocked felt bags with multiple colors?

Yes! Color-blocked designs are one of our specialties. We can combine 2-3 felt colors in a single bag — for example, a natural body with colored handles and accents. This creates a unique, branded look that stands out.

How long does production take?

Standard production is 7-15 business days. Rush orders are available in 5-7 days with a 20% surcharge. Shipping via sea freight takes 15-30 days; air freight 5-10 days.

What file format do you need for my logo?

Vector files (.AI, .EPS, .SVG) are preferred for crisp printing. High-resolution PNG or PDF (300 DPI minimum) also accepted. Our design team can help prepare your artwork at no additional cost.
